title: External institutional review gate: Ukrainian Ministry of Defence / Central Research Institute assessment of SCOBY bacterial-cellulose and tactile-thermal sensor concept

source_document.issuing_institution_en: Central Research Institute of Armament and Military Equipment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
source_document.signatory_role_uk: ТВО начальника Центрального науково-дослідного інституту озброєння та військової техніки Збройних Сил України
source_document.source_medium: digitally signed official letter / screenshot supplied by observer
source_document.privacy_policy: Home address, certificate serial, telephone details and other unnecessary personal identifiers visible in the source document are intentionally omitted from the public registry record.

reviewed_subject.institutional_description_uk: експериментальний матеріалознавчий напрям біокомпозитних матеріалів на основі бактеріальної целюлози та тактильно-теплової сенсорної оболонки
normalized_program_mapping: tactile and thermal sensing skin / sensor-shell concept
reviewed_subject.registry_scope_note: The institutional response addresses the combined materials-and-sensor concept at a program level. It does not validate any individual D1 branch such as chitin reinforcement, electrosynthesis, basalt comparison or thermal processing.

finding_01.normalized_statement: The submitted materials do not yet contain an experimental evidence base and test results sufficient to evaluate the practical suitability of the proposed solutions.

finding_02.normalized_statement: The proposed direction is regarded as current/relevant, but has characteristics of an early-stage materials-science and sensor hypothesis or concept.

finding_03.normalized_statement: Independent professional verification in a specialized materials-science laboratory is required before a reasoned decision on further development can be made.

finding_04.normalized_statement: The Ministry of Defence does not have the required materials-science laboratories for this evaluation and recommends approaching the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine or the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine.

not_admitted: TRL promotion based solely on institutional correspondence
claim_ceiling.rule: An institutional statement that the direction is relevant does not constitute technical validation of performance.

mapping_to_canonical_epistemic_model.external_confirmation: The institutional assessment independently converges with the registry rule that application suitability cannot be evaluated before real experimental evidence and independent validation.
mapping_to_canonical_epistemic_model.important_boundary: This convergence supports the research governance approach; it does not validate any specific material hypothesis.

new_external_validation_gate.objective: Obtain independent laboratory characterization of at least one clearly scoped SCOBY-D1 material question using traceable specimens, methods, raw measurements and controls.
minimum_submission_package: specific branch protocol rather than the entire hypothesis corpus
copy or summary of the Ukrainian MoD referral letter
preferred_first_material_questions: GEN0 versus GEN1 baseline architecture characterization
exogenous crustacean-chitin incorporation versus matched no-chitin control
new_external_validation_gate.reason_for_priority: These questions are experimentally tractable, directly materials-science focused, and can generate the first causal dataset without requiring the more confounded electrochemical or multifunctional branches.

route_A.normalized_target_en: Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine
route_A.purpose: Request referral or connection to an appropriate university/materials-science laboratory or research infrastructure capable of independent characterization.

route_B.normalized_target_en: National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine
route_B.purpose: Request referral to an institute or laboratory with expertise in polymer, cellulose, composite, surface, microscopy and mechanical characterization.

recommended_outreach_route.routing_rule: Present the request as a request for independent materials characterization and scientific collaboration, not as a request to certify a finished defence product.

submission_strategy.phase_1: Send a concise institutional inquiry to both MON and NAS referring to the MoD institute recommendation.
submission_strategy.phase_2: Ask for referral to a laboratory with bacterial-cellulose / polymer-composite / mechanical-characterization capability.
submission_strategy.phase_3: Provide one tightly scoped D1 protocol and specimen plan after a laboratory expresses interest.
submission_strategy.phase_4: Freeze the protocol and sample identifiers before measurements.
submission_strategy.phase_5: Register raw external laboratory results without modifying prior simulations or hypotheses.
submission_strategy.phase_6: Only after independent results, update the relevant D1 branch evidence level.

recommended_scientific_package.simulation_warning: The electrosynthesis simulation must be labeled MODEL_ONLY and should not be presented as experimental evidence.

institutional_response_interpretation.practical_meaning: The next persuasive object is not a broader concept note but a small, well-controlled, independently measured materials dataset.

next: register outbound correspondence and replies as external-validation provenance

authority_rule: This artifact records and normalizes an external institutional assessment. The original signed document remains the authoritative source for the institution's wording; this JSON is a research-governance interpretation and provenance index, not a substitute for the original letter.
